title: Thin surface subgroups of non-uniform arithmetic lattices in $\rm{SO}^+(n,1)$
summary: We show that the fundamental groups of all non-compact, arithmetic, hyperbolic, $n$-manifolds for $n\geq 4$ contain thin surface subgroups. As a consequence of the proof of this theorem we also show that the fundamental groups of the doubles of cusped, arithmetic, hyperbolic $n$-manifolds embed as GFERF subgroups of $\rm{SO}^+(n+1,1)$.
